groups.name: NASDAQ SETUP
groups.label: Strong Negative
groups.explanation:
⚠️ Material bearish change. Treasury yields remain the main pressure point, with the 2Y at 4.598% and the 10Y at 4.919%. Semiconductor momentum remains an important equity confirmation: SOXX has fallen for 3 consecutive sessions. QQQ is -4.37% over five sessions and -6.47% versus its 20-day average. Brent is +1.74% at about $106.59, adding some inflation pressure.

The Nasdaq Setup is strong negative (-52/100, 71% confidence, deteriorating ↓). The current balance is limited positive confirmation on the supportive side versus elevated/rising Treasury yields, weaker intraday semiconductor leadership, semiconductor/AI leaders trading below their earnings AVWAPs as the main headwind.

Near-term risk is concentrated in semiconductor leadership is lagging QQQ, volatility is rising. Improvement in these conditions would strengthen the setup; further deterioration would reduce conviction.
